releases.notes:
## AutomationEra 0.2.0-1.21.11 更新日志 / Changelog

### 新功能 / New
- 3D 教程从 1.21.5 移植到 1.21.11，改用离屏渲染。 / 3D tutorials ported from 1.21.5 to 1.21.11 using off-screen rendering.
- 机器教程按层重新拆分步骤，第 N 步显示第 1～N 步的全部方块，黄框标出这一步新加的部分。 / Machine tutorials re-split by layer: step N shows every block from steps 1 to N, with a yellow box around the new blocks.
- 小机器和特殊机器保持原来的分步方式不变。 / Small and special machines keep their original steps.
- 羊毛农场补全为完整的机器结构。 / Wool Farm completed into the full machine.
- 3D 查看：左右拖旋转，上下拖调仰角（±90°），Shift+拖平移，滚轮缩放。 / 3D view: drag left/right to rotate, drag up/down to change pitch (±90°), Shift+drag to pan, scroll to zoom.
- 材料表 NORM 显示到当前步为止的全部材料，DIFF 只显示这一步的材料。 / Material list: NORM shows all materials up to the current step, DIFF shows only this step's materials.
- 投影导出改为导出整台机器。 / NBT export now saves the whole machine.
- REI 机器页新增"打开 3D 教程"按钮。 / REI machine pages get an "Open 3D tutorial" button.
- 新增成就：小型经验农场、源源不断、这不可能！？（100/500/1000 级）。 / New advancements: Small XP Farm, Endless Flow, This Is Impossible!? (levels 100/500/1000).
- 新增成就：你不再纯净，下辖 MASA 全家桶、CARPET、优化（检测客户端模组）。 / New advancement: Not Vanilla Anymore, with MASA Suite, CARPET and Optimization under it (detects client-side mods).
- 新增成就：下界合金信标（满级全下界合金信标，奖励 10000 经验）。 / New advancement: Netherite Beacon (full-level beacon made entirely of netherite blocks, 10000 XP reward).
- 新增隐藏开发者选项：是否开启生电成就、是否开启成就奖励。 / Hidden developer options: enable/disable the mod's advancements and their rewards.
- REI 配方按服务器缓存，进入没装 REI 的服务器时自动读取本地缓存。 / REI recipes are cached per server and loaded from the local cache on servers without REI.
- 矿车运输教程图新增英文版，非中文语言时自动切换。 / The Minecart Transport tutorial image has an English version, used automatically when the game language isn't Chinese.

### 调整 / Changes
- 机器成就条件：原 4 组改为 9 组，原 9 组改为 27 组或 1 盒，原 1 盒改为 9 盒。 / Machine advancement goals: 4 stacks → 9 stacks, 9 stacks → 27 stacks or 1 shulker box, 1 box → 9 boxes.
- 恶魂、凋零骷髅、杀凋机、兔子、炼药机、海龟、晒铜、混凝土这几个成就保持原条件。 / The Ghast, Wither Skeleton, Wither, Rabbit, Potion, Turtle, Copper and Concrete advancements keep their original goals.
- 成就树：新增母成就"生物农场"，"村民工程"改为到达村庄触发，并成为自动农场的上级。 / Advancement tree: new root "Creature Farms"; "Village Project" now triggers on reaching a village and is the parent of Auto Crop Farm.
- 自动化工厂改为获得红石粉触发，生电革命改为获得普通潜影盒触发。 / Automatic Factory now triggers on obtaining redstone dust; Survival Curcuit Revolution on obtaining a plain shulker box.
- 鱿鱼农场拆分为普通和发光两个，蜂蜜农场和蜜脾农场分别改名。 / Squid Farm split into Squid and Glow Squid farms; the two bee farms renamed to Honey Farm and Honeycomb Farm.
- 烤鸡机改为三选一，熔炉组和大型熔炉组改为"或"条件。 / Chicken Cooker accepts any one of its three items; Furnace Array and Large Furnace Array now use "or".
- 超平坦世界不再触发空置域。 / Perimeter advancements no longer trigger in superflat worlds.
- REI 页面文字按像素宽度自动换行，放不下时自动缩小字号。 / REI page text wraps by pixel width and shrinks when it doesn't fit.

### 修复 / Fixes
- 3D 渲染方块镜像（左右反了）。 / 3D view was mirrored left-to-right.
- "1 盒"类成就永远无法触发。 / "1 shulker box" advancements could never trigger.
- 专用服务器因调用客户端类而崩溃。 / Dedicated servers crashed from calling a client-only class.
- 多人服务器上挂机、旅行、熔炉、侦测器成就计数串到别的玩家身上。 / AFK, travel, furnace and observer counters were shared between all players on multiplayer servers.
- "50 人服"成就永远拿不到。 / The 50-player server advancement was unreachable.
- 放置侦测器成就不计数。 / Placing observers didn't count toward the observer advancement.
- 冰船测速不准。 / Ice-boat speed was measured wrong.
- 卡服成就误触发。 / The laggy-server advancement triggered falsely.
- REI 渔夫和农民图片被挤窄。 / Fisherman and farmer images in REI were squeezed.
- 高频电路教程图片无法加载。 / The High-Frequency Circuits tutorial image failed to load.
- REI 英文文字超出边框。 / English text overflowed REI pages.
- 教程界面按钮每帧重复添加，越用越卡。 / Tutorial screen re-added its buttons every frame and got slower the longer it was open.
- 主界面标题看不见。 / The tutorial main screen title was invisible.
- 缩放快捷键直接缩到最小。 / Zoom hotkeys jumped straight to minimum zoom.

...
